title: Inverter Fault and Downtime Alert
dataSources: SolarEdge/Enphase production (`solaredge:power`, `enphase:production`), Powerwall (`powerwall:aggregate`), smart-meter P1/DSMR (`dsmr:telegram`), Emporia Vue (`emporia:circuit`).
app: Solar inverters (SolarEdge/Enphase/Fronius/Growatt), Tesla Powerwall, and smart meters (P1/DSMR, Emporia Vue, Sense) via vendor APIs and MQTT to HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=solaredge:power
| eval daylight=if(strftime(_time,"%H")>=9 AND strftime(_time,"%H")<=16,1,0)
| where daylight=1
| stats sum(eval(production_wh=0)) as zero_intervals, count as intervals by _time
| bin _time span=1d
| stats sum(zero_intervals) as dead_intervals by _time
| where dead_intervals>4
description: Detects daylight hours when your inverter produced nothing, catching a tripped or failed inverter on the day it happens rather than at the next bill.
value: An inverter that trips out on a sunny morning can cost a day's generation unnoticed; a same-day alert protects your production.
implementation: Ingest inverter production; schedule mid-afternoon and alert on unexpected zero-production during daylight.
visualization: Timeline of production with dead-interval markers.
grandmaExplanation: It notices when your solar system stops making power on a sunny day, so you can restart it and not lose a day's generation.
